caption: The drawing features three main objects arranged vertically on an off-white, slightly yellowed background. At the top is an oval-shaped medallion or locket colored in dark brown or black with a gold loop at the top for hanging; it has a golden letter "A" on its front. Below that, in the center of the image, is a second oval locket displayed open in two halves, both with gold loops at their tops. The left half contains a small, detailed portrait of a person's head and shoulders on a light background, bordered by the dark frame of the locket, while the right half is empty with just the dark oval frame visible. Below these, sketched in faint pencil, is a simple outline of another oval object with a loop, not fully colored or detailed. The composition is sparse, with significant blank space surrounding the centrally aligned objects.
title: Locket
